article.title: Clasificador libro: 권
article.chapter: Números, clasificadores, hora y fecha — 수사·단위명사·시간·날짜

claims.summary: KRdict defines 권 as a bound noun for counting books or notebooks and gives examples 공책 한 권, 교과서 두 권, 교재 세 권, 노트 네 권, and 책 한 권; this review is limited to that sense and those listed examples.

locator.source: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean-English Learners’ Dictionary, headword 권 (卷), sense 1
locator.detail: The definition says 책이나 공책을 세는 단위 (unit for counting books or notebooks); examples include 공책 한 권, 교과서 두 권, 교재 세 권, 노트 네 권, and 책 한 권. The same headword page distinguishes separate senses for ordinal volume numbers and other historical uses.

links.notes: La afirmación se acotó al primer sentido lexicográfico y a los ejemplos que aparecen expresamente en la entrada; se retiraron afirmaciones generales sobre frecuencia y productividad no acreditadas por este localizador.
